title: Trump's Congress Moves Blue—Are You Riding the Market Wave?
author: OutcomeRich987
selftext: [Democrats flipped Texas and Ohio governor seats, shifting focus to solar, AI infrastructure and oil trades.](https://www.moomoo.com/news/post/1003469485?global_content=%7B"promote_content":"11067213","promote_id":20795,"promote_type":43,"sub_promote_id":1%7D) Post-midterm S&P 500 historically notches solid 12-month gains, but overnight futures whipsawed hard. Traders are eyeing protection plays as policy volatility calms. Solar ETFs saw massive volume spikes, crypto regulation shifts are still up in the air. Who’s got their watchlist locked in right now?

comments.author: Stunning_Room7648
comments.body: Governor flips hit local policy execution first, solar and data center permits are most sensitive. That 12-month historical gain is a reference, not this year's script.
